mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_history ( user_id, item_id, point_type, amount, content ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{itemId}, #{pointType}, #{amount}, #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT point_log_id, user_id, item_id, point_type, amount, content, created_at FROM point_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, point_log_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
